en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a fortified medieval gate with two large cylindrical towers topped by crenellations, joined by an arched entrance with classical pediment. A low bridge or causeway crosses a moat or river in the foreground. Behind the gate are dense urban buildings and, further back, the towers of a large cathedral. On one of the background buildings, commercial signage is visible.
